package.name: imu_driver
package.description: ROS 2 driver for Inertial Labs KERNEL-family IMUs and other devices that speak the same Inertial Labs binary wire protocol (0xAA 0x55 framing, per the KERNEL IMU ICD rev 1.39). Publishes sensor_msgs/Imu and sensor_msgs/Temperature from the device "Calibrated HR Data" output, plus health diagnostics decoded from the Unit Status Word. Data is published in the IMU's own sensor frame; mounting is resolved via URDF/TF.
